description: Add a bare tracked entry (name + optional note) to a campaign's world graph - NO AI content is generated. For a full AI-written NPC, monster, quest etc. with stats and a portrait, use a fixed generation tool such as chargen_generate_npc or chargen_generate_monster instead. A matching entry may have its name, pin state or status updated; new description and note text is appended.

entity_type.description: NPC, MONSTER, LOCATION, FACTION or ITEM

name: chargen_track_entity
title: Track world entity
